summary: Iteration 2 re-test after fixes. All 3 critical bugs from iter 1 are RESOLVED: (1) demo login now works for all 4 @demo.local users (backend LoginIn.email switched to str); (2) /ordini renders sidebar + orders table + 'Simula ordine Shopify' form; (3) /sistema/sincronizzazioni renders sidebar + sync jobs table. ErrorBoundary + Toaster are wired in App.js. Full pytest suite: 31/33 pass; 2 failures are STOCK DATA depletion from cumulative test runs (not real bugs). One NEW backend bug found & fixed by tester: GET /api/audit-logs returned 500 due to ObjectId in nested details field (previous promotion audit stored the raw insert_one-mutated doc). Fixed by cleaning details on write + defensive strip on read. Logout + demo relogin verified working.

minor.issue: Was returning 500: 'ObjectId is not iterable' because create_promotion stored the raw insert_one-mutated `doc` (with _id) inside audit_logs.details. Tester fixed by (a) stripping _id before log_audit and (b) defensively popping details._id in list_audit. Please review other log_audit calls that pass a full mongo doc as details.
Still uses JWT auth via Depends(get_current_user_dep); a real Shopify webhook cannot send a JWT. Needs HMAC signature verification for production.
allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec. Should use explicit FRONTEND_URL origin.
SKU uniqueness checked mid-loop after product doc already inserted; on partial failure product is orphaned. Validate SKUs upfront.

issues: Demo user buttons only pre-fill the form; user must still click 'Entra'. This is by design but could be surfaced with a hint (or auto-submit after selection).
Backend 401 responses still surface only as a browser console error — no on-screen error toast (Toaster is mounted globally now but the Login page catch block doesn't emit toast on wrong password).

action_items: OPTIONAL: audit all log_audit(..., doc) call sites — pass a clean projection instead of the raw insert_one-mutated document to avoid ObjectId in audit details.
OPTIONAL: on Login.jsx submit, emit toast.error(e.response?.data?.detail || 'Credenziali non valide') so wrong password fails visibly.
OPTIONAL: HMAC signature auth for /api/shopify/webhook/order (currently JWT-only), tighten CORS to explicit origin.

The 2 remaining pytest failures (test_A_sale_donna1 and test_E_webhook_idempotent) are seed-stock exhaustion after many iterations; consider running a `POST /api/admin/reseed` (if any) or refactoring these tests to first create a fresh product with initial stock.
critical_code_review_comments: log_audit is called in several places with a mongo-loaded doc directly (e.g. line 806 promotions previously); any such call re-introduces ObjectId in audit details. Prefer projections like {'name': doc['name'], ...} or apply clean() before passing.
server.py still 830+ lines; split into routers per domain (auth/catalog/inventory/pos/shopify/csv/admin).
Login.jsx does not surface backend error message on failed login — combined with reserved-TLD emails, users can be silently stuck.

success_rate.backend: 94% (31/33 pytest; 2 remaining failures are seed-stock depletion, not code bugs)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 3 previously-broken pages now render; demo login E2E works)

audit_logs_500_new.reproduce: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <admin>' /api/audit-logs -> 500 after at least one POST /api/promotions was made (which stored the raw mongo doc — with _id — inside audit_logs.details).
audit_logs_500_new.root_cause: server.py line 806 did `await log_audit('PROMOTION', 'promotion', doc['id'], user, doc)` where `doc` had been mutated by insert_one and carried a bson ObjectId under `_id`. Fastapi's jsonable_encoder blew up on serialization.
audit_logs_500_new.mitigation: Applied by tester: (1) pass {k:v for k,v in doc.items() if k!='_id'} to log_audit; (2) list_audit defensively pops details._id.
